crystalline_red_baseline.relation_to_causal_commit: The binary names the parent commit. The causal commit changes only the four P1461 documentation and L0 files listed in baseline.head_delta_from_parent, with no productive-code delta. This binary is admitted only as the exact RED baseline runner. A final candidate must be rebuilt and rehashed.

full_corpus_runs_required: once after all affected slices and boundary controls pass
calibration_budget.when_exhausted: Stop without sealing; emit an insufficiency diagnostic and obtain human authorization before changing observability, protocol, fixtures, or scope. Budget exhaustion never converts Unknown to Preserved and never lowers mutation_score_required.

calibration_revision.expected_discriminatory_gain: R2 must first distinguish P00 from E05 by isolated build provenance while preserving identical language observations; only then may it execute the remaining controls and mutants.

r1_outcome.reported_hash_precision: Prefixes exactly as supplied by the public R1 cause. The adversary must verify and record full SHA-256 digests before preservation or replacement; ambiguity is Unknown.

r2_build_isolation.build_clean_definition: Each variant starts from a newly created empty target directory and may not reuse a target, cache, fingerprint or incremental directory from any other variant or prior attempt.

e05.binary_identity_requirement: E05 SHA-256 must differ from P00 SHA-256
e05.build_profile: debug/dev, or another explicitly named non-P00 profile if debug/dev is unavailable
e05.language_requirement: C01-C10 observations applicable to the positive control must equal P00
e05.source_identity_requirement: exactly the same positive source hash as P00

forbidden: shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR between P00, E01-E06 or M01-M08
shared target cache, fingerprint or incremental state between variants
copying or relabelling one built binary as another variant
r2_build_isolation.target_dir_rule: P00, every E01-E06 and every M01-M08 receive a unique absolute CARGO_TARGET_DIR recorded in the build receipt.
r2_build_isolation.version_and_bytes_rule: --version text and binary bytes are provenance/identity evidence only, not the language observable; E05 is Preserved by equal language observations despite its required distinct binary hash.

r2_focal_order.release_condition: Run E01-E04, E06 and M01-M08 only after E05 is Preserved, its source equals P00, its binary hash differs from P00 and both build identities are unequivocal.
r2_focal_order.stop_condition: If the focal P00+E05 slice is Unknown or Violated, do not run the remainder and do not perform a third local attempt on the same E05 fixture. Reopen architecture or obtain a new human-authorized hypothesis.

calibration_revision.r2_hypothesis: R1 reused Cargo target cache/fingerprints across nominal variants, so E05 did not materialize as an independent build. Unique empty target directories plus an explicitly distinct E05 build profile will produce an inequivalent binary identity from the same positive source while preserving all language observations.

classification_cost.process_or_wall_clock_cost: not present in the public R2 cause; the R3 receipt must recover it from owner receipts or classify it Unknown

r3_archive_before_replace.rule: For each listed R2 artifact that is still present, its owner must create a byte-for-byte archive, verify equality and record the full source/archive SHA-256 before replacement. Adversary metadata is included when it will be reemitted. Prefix-only identity or mismatch is Unknown and blocks R3.

r3_historical_audit_limitation.impact: This limits byte-level historical auditability of R2 manifest/contract. It does not change the semantic contract, C01-C10, Unknown fail-closed policy, mutant meanings or mutation_score_required=1.0, but it must be disclosed by the next preseal and any final attestation.
r3_historical_audit_limitation.no_reconstruction: The R2 hashes remain identified in R2 receipts, but the bytes were not archived separately before R3 substitution. Do not reconstruct or claim byte-for-byte preservation after the fact.

expected_missing_module_field.exit_0_with_parseable_json: Violated, never Preserved and never Unknown
expected_missing_module_field.recognized_incompatible_semantic_diagnos: Violated, including field access on none when missing-module-field was expected
expected_missing_module_field.recognized_matching_missing_module_field: Preserved only when all contracted module, field and span predicates match
unknown_only: a genuinely unrecognized or unparseable diagnostic

r3_execution_order.release_condition: M02, M06 and M07 are provenance-valid Violated; P00 and E05 remain Preserved with unequivocal distinct build identities.

calibration_revision.r3_hypothesis: The R2 binaries discriminate the required semantics, but the oracle conflated recognized semantic mismatches with parser opacity. Classifying parseable success and recognized incompatible diagnostic categories as Violated will reject M02, M06 and M07 while retaining Unknown only for genuinely opaque or infrastructural outcomes.

r3_reuse_without_rebuild.adversary_action: Re-chain R3 metadata only; do not alter mutant/control source, worktree content or binaries.
